item.title: Lee says he wishes he could apologize to North Korea for Yoon’s drone incursion
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said Wednesday that he wishes he could apologize to North Korea for his impeached predecessor’s alleged drone operations against Pyongyang, while calling it politically difficult to do so. item.title: Seoul boosts spending on inter-Korean cooperation, but guts human rights budget
item.description: Seoul’s unification ministry will increase spending on inter-Korean cooperation by over 25% in the next fiscal year, while almost completely gutting its budget for promoting North Korean human rights.
